purpose: Bounded plain-module TypeScript restoration for Octane issues #726 and #721; not a full upstream parity verification.

excluded: upstream test-suite inventory or full-surface parity

adaptations.description: Preserve the reviewed Recharts 3.9.2 algorithms and source comments; restore annotations and omitted type-only support modules. Replace React renderable/event/ref types with Octane/native contracts and resolve authored component imports explicitly through .tsrx.

Retain the existing react-to-octane, react-redux-to-@octanejs/redux, and es-toolkit compatibility-barrel import adaptations. These substitutions are disclosed normalization steps, not claims that the two renderer APIs are identical.
Preserve the previous compiled port constants: devToolsEnabled=true, isDev=true, and immutableCheck=false. Do not reintroduce source-level process.env reads into browser consumer programs.

Retain the existing port native-event adapter bodies. Derive native event argument types from Octane SVG props, but keep the existing runtime event whitelist; unsupported inherited native event keys are not silently exposed as child callbacks.

Retain each original inline reducer object. Private callbacks accept unknown state only at the RTK validation boundary; every access is asserted to Draft<ExactState>, and public state/action types remain exact. Assertions erase, avoiding recursive DOM-ref comparisons without extra runtime objects, operations, or changed mutations.

Retain the original enhancer callback and legacy array branch. A private union and ReturnType assertion describe the installed Redux Toolkit 2 callback API without changing emitted runtime code, auto-batching or middleware order.

Remove the React-only persist() call from native events. Retain currentTarget capture and native method binding across the existing requestAnimationFrame throttle. This is the intentional runtime defect correction.

Type the existing Cell registry and numeric shape geometry, preserve SVG ref sinks via type-only renderer views, and retain known prop value types through SVG attribute filtering. Registry/filter runtime bodies are unchanged.
Expose component types with export type * while retaining every original runtime re-export: Bar, computeBarRectangles, defaultBarProps, Line, computeLinePoints and defaultLineProps.

Restore the exact pinned isPolarCoordinate runtime guard, which existing cursor paths import but the previous handwritten type module omitted. Retain the prior event adapter and isNonEmptyArray runtime bodies.

Add a bounded predicate overload to Boolean for array-or-undefined domains while retaining its existing callable/constructor signatures. The assertion erases to the original filter(Boolean) callback; it adds no runtime wrapper.

Preserve generic stack Datum and Key types, including numeric and function DataKeys. The @types/d3-shape 3.1.7 declarations used by a combined packed Visx/Recharts consumer incorrectly describe offsets as receiving one Series; 3.1.8 and the actual D3 runtime pass an array of Series. Bounded intersection overloads adapt imported offsets and the same-stack offset setter to the verified array contract. The assertions erase, and both exact declaration versions pass strict source checks; no dependency pin or callback wrapper is introduced.

verification.sourceArchive: SHA-256 matched the existing reviewed UPSTREAM.md pin; archive members were checked for traversal and links before extraction.
verification.npmArtifact: Official package name, version, MIT license and registry SHA-512 integrity were verified before extracting the comparison artifact.

structuralComparator.description: Compares original JS against pristine npm es6, restored TS against immutable repository TS after erasure, and existing authored TS against the baseline commit. Results and reviewed differences are bounded structural evidence, not proof of complete runtime parity.
normalizations: TypeScript-only declarations and assertions erased using transpileModule(target=ES2022,module=ESNext)
AST kinds, literal/identifier text, declaration kind and ordered children compared; comments/formatting/redundant parentheses ignored
Relative module dot segments and .js/.ts/.tsrx suffixes normalized for authored-source resolution
Import groups sorted, preserving imported/local names; documented react->octane, react-redux->@octanejs/redux and es-toolkit compatibility-barrel substitutions applied

reviewedSourceDifferences.classification: Only immutableCheck=false differs from the pinned repository body; this preserves the previous compiled port preset. The original enhancer callback and array branch are retained.
Only devToolsEnabled=true differs, preserving the previous compiled port preset.
Only isDev=true differs, preserving the previous compiled port preset.
Exactly one React-only persist() call is removed; all remaining proxy statements match the pinned source. Native event regression fails before the fix and passes after it.

Retains the original Octane-native event adapters and isNonEmptyArray body instead of React-owned helpers. Restores isPolarCoordinate with a body identical to the pin; the four existing runtime helper bodies match the previous authored port.

authoredTypesDifference.classification: The only authored-source runtime addition is the pinned isPolarCoordinate guard; existing helper bodies are preserved.

nativeEventRegression.result: 5 tests passed on the installed Redux Toolkit 2.10.1 / Immer 10.2.0 graph. The original persist() behavior failed with TypeError and did not invoke the chart callback.

strictSourceCheck.result: Final restored source passes without diagnostics against installed Redux Toolkit 2.10.1 / Immer 10.2.0 and @types/d3-shape 3.1.8, including inline reducer assertions, erased Boolean narrowing, and the unchanged enhancer body.

d3CompatibilityExperiment.method: Run the same strict consumer source program with skipLibCheck=false, overriding only the d3-shape declaration path to the exact 3.1.7 package resolved by the fresh combined packed consumer. This verifies the local declaration adapter, not the complete packed consumer.

conformance.scope: Repository-authored conformance tests; separate recharts-differential project is not included.
conformance.note: The focused run passed all 36 conformance tests. The final normal-root shards subsequently passed all 39 Recharts cases across these four files and the three-case differential file; that coverage is part of the full-root result, not a separate 39-test invocation.

formatting.scope: Owned ordinary TypeScript, native regression test, comparison script, package manifest, and restoration record.

fullRootRuntime.scope: All normal-root Vitest projects, with no project or test exclusions, including Recharts conformance and differential cases. The root test prechecks passed separately. The original unsharded run exhausted the default 4 GiB heap and is not counted as a pass.

packedConsumer.scope: Actual tarballs installed outside the workspace. The five issue bindings pass a normal source-only ESNext browser application and canonical full-implementation browser/Node programs with strict checking and skipLibCheck=false. Negative Node ambient, prop, callback, ref, generic, and tuple probes remain active. All 348 shipped TSRX implementations are in the forced program. Runtime/tooling resolutions stay outside the workspace, with one Octane installation and no consumer dependency overrides or patches. The old Recharts facade fails the same public probes. Other existing binding exceptions remain explicit; current-head CI is reported separately on the PR.
